Nina: quick idea 12 run a focused sim for launch week: surge x3 traffic for 20m, show claim <=60s p95 and owner ack <=2m p95.
Omar: ok. will model enrichment slow tail (up to 3s) + occasional missing owner metadata from HS.
Janet: can we test two fixes: 1) rr with jitter+decay, 2) rr+overflow pool? need fallback to default-owner flagged in logs.
Nina: exactly. capture metrics: claim_latency_ms, owner_ack_ms, fallback_type, claim_attempts.
Omar: config sketch:
```
rr_jitter_ms: 300
consec_limit: 2
overflow_pool: 5
ack_timeout_s: 120
```
Janet: i'll schedule NA and EMEA canaries and include timezone skew for EMEA owners. also add heartbeat probe 15s to reduce double-claims.
ops-bot: Simulation scheduled: 2025-08-03T04:00Z. Artifacts -> /sim-results/launch-inbound/1765009999.
Nina: perfect. Omar/Janet run baseline + both variants, post CSV + 1-paragraph summary. i'll draft the playbook blurb with rollback steps. :rocket:
